rows.source_text:
提示说明：
一、本游戏是一款玩法相对复杂的角色扮演类游戏，适用于年满12周岁及以上的用户，建议未成年人在家长监护下使用游戏产品。
二、本游戏基于架空的故事背景和东方幻想世界观，画面色彩鲜明、配乐活泼激昂，部分英雄角色有基于历史的适量改编，不会与现实相混淆。玩家将结识熟悉的王者英雄，在战斗、探险与历练的过程中，谱写自己在王者大陆的故事。游戏以广阔的幻想世界探索为主要玩法，部分对抗内容以非写实的形式出现，不会与现实生活相混淆，鼓励玩家通过思考和训练达成目标。游戏中有基于文字的陌生人社交系统，但社交系统的管理遵循相关法律法规。
三、根据国家相关要求，游戏中有用户实名认证系统，未通过实名认证的用户不可进入游戏；认证为未成年人的用户除周五、周六、周日及法定节假日每日20时至21时外其他时间均不可进入游戏。
游戏中部分玩法和道具需要付费。根据腾讯健康系统管理规定，认证为未成年人的用户将接受以下管理：
未满12周岁的用户不能付费；12周岁以上未满16周岁的未成年人用户，单次充值金额不得超过50元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过200元人民币；16周岁以上的未成年人用户，单次充值金额不得超过100元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过400元人民币。
四、游戏中玩家需要根据不同的共鸣特性养成角色，并合理的分配资源来提升自身的强度，有助于锻炼玩家的逻辑思维能力与思考判断能力；战斗中根据对手的动作进行攻击或躲避，有助于锻炼玩家的手眼协调能力和快速反应能力。
rows.target_text:
Disclaimers:

1. This game is a complex role-playing game for users aged 12 and above. Players under 18 should play with parental supervision.

2. The game is set in a fictional Eastern fantasy world with bright graphics and lively music. Some characters are loosely based on history but are clearly fictional. Players will meet familiar characters from Honor of Kings and create their own stories through battles, adventures, and training. The game focuses on exploring a vast fantasy world and includes some non-realistic combat elements. It encourages strategic thinking and problem-solving. The game has a text-based social system for chatting with strangers, managed according to laws.

3. To comply with national regulations, the game requires real-name verification. Users who do not verify cannot play. Verified players under 18 can only play from 8 PM to 9 PM on Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays. Some game features and items require payment. According to Tencent's regulations, players under 18 have the following payment limits:
-Users under 12 cannot make payments.
-Users aged 12 to 15 can spend up to 50 CNY per transaction and 200 CNY per month.
-Users aged 16 to 17 can spend up to 100 CNY per transaction and 400 CNY per month.

4. Players need to develop Flow Styles with different traits and wisely allocate resources to become stronger. This helps improve logical thinking and decision-making skills. During battles, players must attack or dodge based on opponents' actions, which helps improve hand-eye coordination and quick reaction skills.

rows.source_text:
玩家按照任务指引完成每日任务、每周任务和挑战任务，将提升【战令等级】。玩家达到指定等级即可领取对应奖励，其中【普通战令】所含奖励皆可免费领取；【甄藏战令】或【荣耀甄藏战令】需花费【璇晶】货币解锁，解锁后可立即获得丰厚奖励，并且随等级提升额外解锁大量甄藏奖励！

<战令等级>
玩家完成每日任务、每周任务或挑战任务，通过任务面板点击领取，获得【战令经验】，可累积提升【战令等级】。玩家也可点击【获得经验】，花费【璇晶】直接购买【战令等级】。本期【战令】上限为50级，达到等级上限后将无法继续积累经验和升级。

<战令任务>
战令任务分为每日、每周、挑战三类任务。每日任务将在每天04:00刷新，每周任务将在每周一04:00刷新，挑战任务将在本期战令内不定期上线。挑战任务上线后，将随本期战令结束而终止，且只可完成一次。玩家在【任务】界面可查看每日、每周、挑战任务明细。每周任务更新后，过往的每周任务将不再展示，且不可再完成。
rows.target_text:
Complete daily, weekly, and challenge quests to increase your Battle Pass Level. Reach specific levels to claim corresponding rewards. All rewards under the Normal Battle Pass are available for free. Premium Battle Pass or Premium Battle Pass Plus rewards can be unlocked using Astral Crystals. Get immediate access to generous rewards upon unlocking, plus earn additional rewards as your level increases!

Battle Pass Level
Complete daily, weekly, or challenge quests to earn Battle Pass EXP. After finishing quests, claim the EXP to level up your Battle Pass, or spend Astral Crystals to upgrade instantly. This season's Battle Pass stops at level 50—once you reach it, you will no longer earn EXP or gain levels.

Battle Pass Quests
Battle Pass Quests are divided into three types: daily, weekly, and challenge quests. Daily Quests reset daily at 04:00. Weekly Quests reset every Monday at 04:00. Challenge Quests will appear randomly during the current Battle Pass season. Once available, they will remain active until the end of the season and can only be completed once. You can view detailed information about daily, weekly, and challenge quests in Quests. After the weekly quests reset, the previous week's quests will no longer be available, and you won't be able to complete them.

rows.source_text: 丰穗流金，青鬓间缠绕着丰收的火色与静谧。
rows.target_text: The raven tresses twine with harvest's fiery glow and serenity among the gliding wheat.
rows.official_target_text: The raven tresses twine with harvest's fiery glow and serenity among the gliding wheat.

rows.source_text: 融入稷下三学院标识的典雅上衣，代表穿戴者已在知识上融会贯通。
rows.target_text: An elegantly designed top featuring emblems of Jixia's three schools—a homage to the convergence of knowledge.
rows.official_target_text: An elegantly designed top featuring emblems of Jixia's three schools—a homage to the convergence of knowledge.

rows.source_text: 送来的时候说“都是好吃的”，可没人说这么重啊！
rows.target_text: They said it was "all delicious food" when they sent it, but nobody said it would be this heavy!
rows.official_target_text: They said it was "all delicious food" when they sent it, but nobody said it would be this heavy!

rows.source_text: 武道学子的最爱的打扮，据说冒险旅行必备，用茁壮的腿毛震慑破门生。
rows.target_text: A martial arts student's favorite outfit. Said to be essential for adventure. Use your thick leg hair to intimidate gate-crashers.
rows.official_target_text: A martial arts student's favorite outfit. Said to be essential for adventure. Use your thick leg hair to intimidate gate-crashers.

rows.source_text: 外观让人联想到锋利的爪牙，据说来源于猩红色的巨大神兽。
rows.target_text: The design resembles sharp claws and teeth, and it is believed to be inspired by a massive red mythical beast.
rows.official_target_text: The design resembles sharp claws and teeth, and it is believed to be inspired by a massive red mythical beast.

rows.source_text: 素袍收束天地清浊，青芒暗绣着风物家心中的山河万卷。
rows.target_text: A plain robe that gathers the clarity and turbidity of the world, with green light subtly embroidering the vast landscapes held in the heart of a Fengwu family member.
rows.official_target_text: A plain robe that gathers the clarity and turbidity of the world, with green light subtly embroidering the vast landscapes held in the heart of a Fengwu family member.

rows.source_text: 最初的风采，启蒙之路，简洁的短发造型，彰显青春活力。
rows.target_text: Radiant youth on the path to wisdom—this simple, short hair embodies youthful vigor.
rows.official_target_text: Radiant youth on the path to wisdom—this simple, short hair embodies youthful vigor.

rows.source_text: 仙鹤雕纹腰牌，正面刻字“鸣”，背面刻字“鹤”。
rows.target_text: A waist token carved with characters: "Ming" on the front and "He" on the back.
rows.official_target_text: A waist token carved with characters: "Ming" on the front and "He" on the back.

rows.source_text: 素白的绵柔袜子。金环与云纹装点，增添了许多喜庆的意味。
rows.target_text: Soft, pure white cotton socks. Adorned with gold rings and cloud patterns, they add a festive touch.
rows.official_target_text: Soft, pure white cotton socks. Adorned with gold rings and cloud patterns, they add a festive touch.

rows.source_text: 幽谷微风中，鬓发轻垂，光照眼睫，留晨曦的余温在发梢绵延。
rows.target_text: In the gentle breeze of the secluded valley, hair falls softly, light catching on eyelashes, leaving the lingering warmth of dawn on the tips of the hair.
rows.official_target_text: In the gentle breeze of the secluded valley, hair falls softly, light catching on eyelashes, leaving the lingering warmth of dawn on the tips of the hair.

rows.source_text: 戴上以咕呱为原型设计的挂饰，意味着佩戴者获得了“咕呱大哥”的认可。
rows.target_text: Wearing it shows you've earned Boss Croaky's recognition.
rows.official_target_text: Wearing it shows you've earned Boss Croaky's recognition.

rows.source_text: 绣着海浪纹的渐变色短上衣，据说衣服上的金线是用颜色明亮的咬指木染成。
rows.target_text: A top that fades in a smooth gradient, decorated with delicate wave embroidery. The shimmering gold threads owe their rich color to dye made from bright Bitewood.
rows.official_target_text: A top that fades in a smooth gradient, decorated with delicate wave embroidery. The shimmering gold threads owe their rich color to dye made from bright Bitewood.

rows.source_text: 融入稷下三学院标识的典雅上衣，代表穿戴者已在知识上融会贯通。
rows.target_text: An elegantly designed top featuring emblems of Jixia's three schools—a homage to the convergence of knowledge.
rows.official_target_text: An elegantly designed top featuring emblems of Jixia's three schools—a homage to the convergence of knowledge.

rows.source_text: 弥漫着山石般温厚光泽的甲靴。特别注重对膝盖的防护，便于登高拾秋。
rows.target_text: Covered in a warm, stone-like luster, these armored boots have enhanced knee protection. Perfect for autumn climbs.
rows.official_target_text: Covered in a warm, stone-like luster, these armored boots have enhanced knee protection. Perfect for autumn climbs.

rows.source_text: 透气舒适的袜子，轻薄如雾霭，行之若清风。
rows.target_text: These breathable, comfortable socks, light as mist, let you move like a breeze.
rows.official_target_text: These breathable, comfortable socks, light as mist, let you move like a breeze.

rows.source_text: 浅色鱼尾长裙，如江中游鳞之影，古典而神秘优雅。
rows.target_text: A light-colored fishtail skirt, like the shadow of scales swimming in a river—classic, mysterious, and elegant.
rows.official_target_text: A light-colored fishtail skirt, like the shadow of scales swimming in a river—classic, mysterious, and elegant.

rows.source_text: 用云丝和云琼矿打造的机关人铠甲，简直以假乱真！穿上说不定能吓人一跳？
rows.target_text: Built with Aersilk and Aernium, this Mechanoid armor is indistinguishable from the real thing. It may surprise people!
rows.official_target_text: Built with Aersilk and Aernium, this Mechanoid armor is indistinguishable from the real thing. It may surprise people!

rows.source_text: 武道学子的最爱打扮，据说冒险必备，腿毛震慑破门生——这是特约加长款。
rows.target_text: A martial arts student's favorite outfit. Said to be essential for adventure. The leg hair intimidates the gate-crashers—this is the special extra-long version.
rows.official_target_text: A martial arts student's favorite outfit. Said to be essential for adventure. The leg hair intimidates the gate-crashers—this is the special extra-long version.

rows.source_text: 伐石为甲，缀以梧桐。为着装者提供重点防护，使之于远山中自在穿行。
rows.target_text: When the mountains turn crimson with autumn leaves, the view from higher ground is at its most brilliant.
rows.official_target_text: When the mountains turn crimson with autumn leaves, the view from higher ground is at its most brilliant.

rows.source_text: 鞋底不知用何材质制成，让人脚掌一落，便陷入一片柔软。
rows.target_text: The soles are crafted from some unknown material that makes every step feel like walking on a soft cloud.
rows.official_target_text: The soles are crafted from some unknown material that makes every step feel like walking on a soft cloud.

rows.source_text: 由尘鹿皮制成的长筒靴，风物家们野外探险的最爱。
rows.target_text: Long boots made from Cloud Stag leather, a favorite of Seekers for outdoor adventures.
rows.official_target_text: Long boots made from Cloud Stag leather, a favorite of Seekers for outdoor adventures.

rows.source_text: 让人联想起危险的红色隼鸟，具有金色羽边的华丽面具。
rows.target_text: A lavish mask inspired by the perilous Red Falcon, embellished with gold-trimmed feathers.
rows.official_target_text: A lavish mask inspired by the perilous Red Falcon, embellished with gold-trimmed feathers.

rows.source_text: 来自辰藏老师的馈赠，等待求知者将其装上满满的知识！
rows.target_text: A gift from Master Chenzang, waiting for a seeker of knowledge to fill it up!
rows.official_target_text: A gift from Master Chenzang, waiting for a seeker of knowledge to fill it up!

rows.source_text: 鎏金半框，绛紫透镜，诡瑰的色调，让人想起那深渊般的双眸。
rows.target_text: Gilded frame and amethyst glow—a haunting hue that mirrors the depths of someone's abyssal eyes.
rows.official_target_text: Gilded frame and amethyst glow—a haunting hue that mirrors the depths of someone's abyssal eyes.

rows.source_text: 深夜图书馆偶尔会响起嚎叫：“以知识为名，以秩序为引！解开吧——”
rows.target_text: Sometimes, you can hear howling from the library at night, "In the name of knowledge and the guidance of order! Open!"
rows.official_target_text: Sometimes, you can hear howling from the library at night, "In the name of knowledge and the guidance of order! Open!"

rows.source_text: 狂风天，发型沉稳如初，烦恼？根本不存在的！
rows.target_text: In a gale, the hairstyle remains as steady as ever. Worries? They don't exist!
rows.official_target_text: In a gale, the hairstyle remains as steady as ever. Worries? They don't exist!

rows.source_text: 墨炎乍现，龙隐于身，似深渊熔岩裂地喷涌。
rows.target_text: A dragon hides inside, like molten rock from the deep bursting up through the ground.
rows.official_target_text: A dragon hides inside, like molten rock from the deep bursting up through the ground.

rows.source_text: 无处寻觅解锁之机的玉锁。内中圆玉时常闪耀金芒，隐约浮现出八柱的纹样。
rows.target_text: A jade lock whose secret remains locked away. The round jade at its center sometimes gleams with golden light, briefly revealing the patterns on the bronze pillars.
rows.official_target_text: A jade lock whose secret remains locked away. The round jade at its center sometimes gleams with golden light, briefly revealing the patterns on the bronze pillars.

rows.source_text: 用料轻薄的短裤，云白素雅，点缀有金色花纹，十分百搭。
rows.target_text: Light, simple shorts in a cloud-white hue, accented with golden patterns. Very versatile.
rows.official_target_text: Light, simple shorts in a cloud-white hue, accented with golden patterns. Very versatile.

rows.source_text: 以加韧纱线织就白袜，伴人踏出悠然而充满活力的步伐。
rows.target_text: Woven from reinforced yarn, these white socks let you walk with both energy and ease.
rows.official_target_text: Woven from reinforced yarn, these white socks let you walk with both energy and ease.

rows.source_text: 宽袖猎猎作响，风拽住衣角，他跃步向前，迎接自由的呼唤。
rows.target_text: Wide sleeves flutter in the wind, catching the breeze as he leaps forward to answer the call of freedom.
rows.official_target_text: Wide sleeves flutter in the wind, catching the breeze as he leaps forward to answer the call of freedom.

rows.source_text: 深色下装，舒适自在，踏遍千山万水，尽显行者的洒脱。
rows.target_text: Dark bottoms that are comfortable and relaxed, capturing the free-spirited nature of a traveler across landscapes.
rows.official_target_text: Dark bottoms that are comfortable and relaxed, capturing the free-spirited nature of a traveler across landscapes.

rows.source_text: 随风高扬的白色发尾，圆圆的虎耳若隐若现，生机勃勃而野性十足。
rows.target_text: White hair tips swaying in the wind, round tiger ears faintly visible, full of vitality and wildness.
rows.official_target_text: White hair tips swaying in the wind, round tiger ears faintly visible, full of vitality and wildness.

rows.source_text: 浅色蓝白的上装，乍看清新，锁边的深紫却依稀藏匿着幽梦。
rows.target_text: Where the Dream Rift gapes wide, radiance and shadows glide forth. You don't need to be in a dream to dress in a feathered robe and walk with cloud-veiled boots.
rows.official_target_text: Where the Dream Rift gapes wide, radiance and shadows glide forth. You don't need to be in a dream to dress in a feathered robe and walk with cloud-veiled boots.

rows.source_text: 暮色染就的灰黑色辫发，甩一甩头，仿佛能落下细碎的流霜。
rows.target_text: Gray-black braided hair dyed by twilight; a shake of the head seems to scatter fine frost.
rows.official_target_text: Gray-black braided hair dyed by twilight; a shake of the head seems to scatter fine frost.

rows.source_text: 浅绿色的荷叶下，蹲着小青蛙，热气噗噗的茶壶，烹煮着顶呱呱的妙想吗？
rows.target_text: A little frog crouching under a light green lotus leaf, a steaming teapot—is it brewing some brilliant ideas?
rows.official_target_text: A little frog crouching under a light green lotus leaf, a steaming teapot—is it brewing some brilliant ideas?

rows.source_text: 简洁潇洒的下装，看起来很方便作战和潜行，逃跑起来也很方便。
rows.target_text: Simple and sleek pants, ideal for combat, stealth, and easy escapes.
rows.official_target_text: Simple and sleek pants, ideal for combat, stealth, and easy escapes.

rows.source_text: 眼中火花乱跳，耳边噼啪作响，赛场奋战的激情，仿佛要点燃发梢。
rows.target_text: Clothes obtained through several hard-fought battles, with fabric mixed with Aersilk and leather from a Wolvine.
rows.official_target_text: Clothes obtained through several hard-fought battles, with fabric mixed with Aersilk and leather from a Wolvine.

rows.source_text: 稷下特色的白瓷云笔，提供给新来学子使用。
rows.target_text: A white porcelain brush typical of Jixia, commonly used by first-year students.
rows.official_target_text: A white porcelain brush typical of Jixia, commonly used by first-year students.

rows.source_text: 武道学子的最爱的打扮，据说冒险旅行必备，用茁壮的腿毛震慑破门生。
rows.target_text: A martial arts student's favorite outfit. Said to be essential for adventure. Use your thick leg hair to intimidate gate-crashers.
rows.official_target_text: A martial arts student's favorite outfit. Said to be essential for adventure. Use your thick leg hair to intimidate gate-crashers.

rows.source_text: 借幽夜净自心，琢星月入饰环。拥簇着的蓝瓣光华于无息中疗愈万物。
rows.target_text: Under the starry night, the blue petals heal all life in their peaceful glow.
rows.official_target_text: Under the starry night, the blue petals heal all life in their peaceful glow.

rows.source_text: 半梦半醒间，穿上了奇怪的拖鞋，唤醒稷下清晨的，是学长学姐们的恶作剧。
rows.target_text: Half-asleep and half-awake, I put on these strange slippers. It was the pranks of the seniors that woke me up on a Jixia morning.
rows.official_target_text: Half-asleep and half-awake, I put on these strange slippers. It was the pranks of the seniors that woke me up on a Jixia morning.

rows.source_text: 深色绸缎裁制的长裤，适合初春时节，去看湖畔燕归。
rows.target_text: These dark silk pants are perfect for an early spring trip to the lake, where you can wait for the swallows to return.
rows.official_target_text: These dark silk pants are perfect for an early spring trip to the lake, where you can wait for the swallows to return.

rows.source_text: 那缠绕踝间的微光，不是束缚，而是宇宙赠予的缄默预言。
rows.target_text: The faint light wrapped around the ankles is not a shackle, but a silent prophecy gifted by the universe.
rows.official_target_text: The faint light wrapped around the ankles is not a shackle, but a silent prophecy gifted by the universe.

rows.source_text: 凌乱而潇洒的短发，自由来去，武道之意，如林中风。
rows.target_text: Tousled short hair that embodies the Martial Arts spirit—to move with the freedom of the forest wind.
rows.official_target_text: Tousled short hair that embodies the Martial Arts spirit—to move with the freedom of the forest wind.

rows.source_text: 湖水山影般的蓝色狼尾发型，是林中小路上跃动的一抹亮色。
rows.target_text: A high ponytail in lake blue hues, reminiscent of a wolf running along a forest trail.
rows.official_target_text: A high ponytail in lake blue hues, reminiscent of a wolf running along a forest trail.

rows.source_text: 袖衫清雅而古典，春雨、春柳、春燕……展现风物家与春光万物的田野。
rows.target_text: An elegant dress with a classic charm. Spring drizzle, willows, swallows... a field for Seekers and everything touched by spring.
rows.official_target_text: An elegant dress with a classic charm. Spring drizzle, willows, swallows... a field for Seekers and everything touched by spring.

rows.source_text: 荷喧知过雨，萍聚见来风，让人想起雨后荷塘碧波的下装，清雅别致。
rows.target_text: Rustling lotus tells of passing rain; duckweeds gather, stirred by the wind—this lower garment evokes the serene beauty of a rain-kissed lotus pond, chic and elegant.
rows.official_target_text: Rustling lotus tells of passing rain; duckweeds gather, stirred by the wind—this lower garment evokes the serene beauty of a rain-kissed lotus pond, chic and elegant.

rows.source_text: 未刻纤痕的镜片，倒映着一片待稷下新生探索真理的天地。
rows.target_text: The untarnished lenses reflect a world of truth waiting for Jixia's new students to explore.
rows.official_target_text: The untarnished lenses reflect a world of truth waiting for Jixia's new students to explore.

rows.source_text: 河道游灵的礼物，精致的荷包，蕴含美好祝愿，佩戴在身上，迎来多多福气。
rows.target_text: This exquisite pouch carries the Mischievous River Sprite's heartfelt wishes. Wear it, and good fortune will follow wherever you go.
rows.official_target_text: This exquisite pouch carries the Mischievous River Sprite's heartfelt wishes. Wear it, and good fortune will follow wherever you go.

rows.source_text: 轻盈飘逸的长裤。风之纹路攀附其上，如同一缕尘世的牵绊，令人流连。
rows.target_text: Light and ethereal long pants. The pattern of the wind clings to them, a lingering tie to the mortal world.
rows.official_target_text: Light and ethereal long pants. The pattern of the wind clings to them, a lingering tie to the mortal world.

rows.source_text: 半梦半醒间，穿上了奇怪的拖鞋，唤醒稷下清晨的，是学长学姐们的恶作剧。
rows.target_text: Half-asleep and half-awake, I put on these strange slippers. It was the pranks of the seniors that woke me up on a Jixia morning.
rows.official_target_text: Half-asleep and half-awake, I put on these strange slippers. It was the pranks of the seniors that woke me up on a Jixia morning.

rows.source_text: 帅到巅峰的萝卜之袍，展示萝中王者的气势，成为萝卜中的萝卜。
rows.target_text: A radish robe handsome to the peak, showing the aura of a king among radishes, becoming the radish of radishes.
rows.official_target_text: A radish robe handsome to the peak, showing the aura of a king among radishes, becoming the radish of radishes.

rows.source_text: 袜子如霜般莹白，仿佛晨间凝结的第一抹寒色，清冷透亮。
rows.target_text: The socks are as white as frost, like the first touch of cold condensed in the morning, clear and cool.
rows.official_target_text: The socks are as white as frost, like the first touch of cold condensed in the morning, clear and cool.

rows.source_text: 紫八鱼玩偶稳坐头顶，小心翼翼握住发丝，随游猎家一起踏上探险之旅。
rows.target_text: A Violet Snapper perches atop the head, clutching the hair with great care as it accompanies the Hunter on every adventure.
rows.official_target_text: A Violet Snapper perches atop the head, clutching the hair with great care as it accompanies the Hunter on every adventure.

rows.source_text: 稷下新星们人手一件的兜帽衫配夜行衣穿搭。
rows.target_text: Every new student at Jixia wears a hooded coat over dark underclothes as their standard outfit.
rows.official_target_text: Every new student at Jixia wears a hooded coat over dark underclothes as their standard outfit.

rows.source_text: 暗色束领，搭配无袖蒹葭纹短上衫，神秘的旅行者，翩然而至。
rows.target_text: A high-collared design in dark hues, paired with a sleeveless reed-patterned short top. A mysterious traveler arrives with grace.
rows.official_target_text: A high-collared design in dark hues, paired with a sleeveless reed-patterned short top. A mysterious traveler arrives with grace.

rows.source_text: 白色短靴，糖果色电玩配饰随步伐跃动，闪闪发光的孩子气。
rows.target_text: White ankle boots adorned with candy-colored gaming trinkets that sparkle with every step, radiating youthful energy.
rows.official_target_text: White ankle boots adorned with candy-colored gaming trinkets that sparkle with every step, radiating youthful energy.

rows.source_text: 这款纪念人灵友谊的发夹，据说能令佩戴者更受河道之灵的青睐。
rows.target_text: A hairpin that celebrates the friendship between humans and sprites, said to endear its wearer to River Sprites.
rows.official_target_text: A hairpin that celebrates the friendship between humans and sprites, said to endear its wearer to River Sprites.

rows.source_text: 肩甲铸成星穹的壁垒，星辰在长袍间闪烁，仿佛某颗星体的心跳，正与之共振。
rows.target_text: The pauldrons are forged into a bastion of the celestial dome, and stars twinkle between the robes, as if the heartbeat of some celestial body is resonating with it.
rows.official_target_text: The pauldrons are forged into a bastion of the celestial dome, and stars twinkle between the robes, as if the heartbeat of some celestial body is resonating with it.

rows.source_text: 优雅的垂羽宝雀，金银杏叶，灵感来自稷下书画大师墨染的佳作。
rows.target_text: An elegant hanging-feather bird with golden ginkgo leaves, inspired by the masterpiece of the Jixia calligraphy and painting master, Mo Ran.
rows.official_target_text: An elegant hanging-feather bird with golden ginkgo leaves, inspired by the masterpiece of the Jixia calligraphy and painting master, Mo Ran.

rows.source_text: 来自星空的祝福，闪闪发光的温柔，化作金灿灿的帽子，伴随新的旅程。
rows.target_text: A blessing from the stars—twinkling love spun into a glimmering hat, ready to join your newest adventure.
rows.official_target_text: A blessing from the stars—twinkling love spun into a glimmering hat, ready to join your newest adventure.

rows.source_text: 头顶被猫咪抓过，挑出几缕灰绿色的碎发。
rows.target_text: Scratched by a cat on the head, a few wispy gray-brown hair peeked out.
rows.official_target_text: Scratched by a cat on the head, a few wispy gray-brown hair peeked out.

rows.source_text: “精力充沛的年轻人，愿胜利属于你。”终日埋首机关的学长，连制作衣物都追求精细。
rows.target_text: "Energetic young one, may victory be yours." The senior student who spends days buried in Mechcraft applies the same precision even to the art of tailoring.
rows.official_target_text: "Energetic young one, may victory be yours." The senior student who spends days buried in Mechcraft applies the same precision even to the art of tailoring.

rows.source_text: 云雾水波图案的面纱，让人想起稷下的风雅。
rows.target_text: A veil with mist and water ripple patterns, evoking the refined elegance of Jixia.
rows.official_target_text: A veil with mist and water ripple patterns, evoking the refined elegance of Jixia.

rows.source_text: 潇洒不羁的短檐斗笠，让武道家的身份神秘莫测了起来。
rows.target_text: A stylish, carefree short-brimmed bamboo hat that adds a mysterious air to the martial artist's identity.
rows.official_target_text: A stylish, carefree short-brimmed bamboo hat that adds a mysterious air to the martial artist's identity.

rows.source_text: 精巧的单片眼镜，魔道与机关的双重融合，似乎戴上它便能看透本源。
rows.target_text: A finely crafted monocle, a blend of the Sorcery and Mechcraft techniques. It seems to allow the wearer to see the very nature of things.

rows.official_target_text: Bright and carefree short hair that gives a cheerful impression.

rows.official_target_text: A soft inner lining resembling rosy clouds, paired with a light, short coat. Fresh and elegant, it blends gentle charm with vitality.

rows.official_target_text: A vibrant radish onesie that really cheers everyone up in the study room.

rows.official_target_text: Walk lightly, as if treading on light reflecting on the fish scales. Each step rings with auspicious melody, awakening the golden autumn.

rows.official_target_text: This perfectly round hood embodies "Jixia chic" the moment you put it on. Could it be enough to fend off a Scholar Goose's attacks?

rows.source_text: 半扎长发低调典雅，发间的古老绳结似乎蕴藏着不为人知的往事。
rows.target_text: Half-tied long hair, simple yet elegant, adorned with ancient knots that seem to hold untold stories.
rows.official_target_text: Half-tied long hair, simple yet elegant, adorned with ancient knots that seem to hold untold stories.

rows.source_text: 以龙角为材雕琢而成的冠，其佩戴者仿佛司掌着狱讼。
rows.target_text: A crown carved from dragon horn, said to grant its wearer authority over the law.
rows.official_target_text: A crown carved from dragon horn, said to grant its wearer authority over the law.

rows.source_text: 元气十足的萝卜之衫，让自习室的大家更带劲了。
rows.target_text: A vibrant radish onesie that really cheers everyone up in the study room.
rows.official_target_text: A vibrant radish onesie that really cheers everyone up in the study room.

rows.source_text: 刘海微微侧分的短发，反翘的小碎发显出设计者的巧思。
rows.target_text: A short cut with slightly side-swept bangs and outward-flipped strands—a neat, playful detail from the stylist.
rows.official_target_text: A short cut with slightly side-swept bangs and outward-flipped strands—a neat, playful detail from the stylist.

rows.source_text: 帅气而尊贵的叶子，带有国王独有的味道。
rows.target_text: Handsome and noble leaves, imbuing the scent of the great monarch.
rows.official_target_text: Handsome and noble leaves, imbuing the scent of the great monarch.

rows.source_text: 柔韧修体的舒适短靴。金青色彩取自古老铜器，却在轻柔的布料上焕发新生。
rows.target_text: Flexible and body-sculpting, comfortable short boots. The gold and azure colors are inspired by ancient bronze, yet revitalized on soft fabric.
rows.official_target_text: Flexible and body-sculpting, comfortable short boots. The gold and azure colors are inspired by ancient bronze, yet revitalized on soft fabric.

rows.source_text: 简约雅致的披发，似云丝轻拢，藏匿对世界的思索，在微风拂动间轻轻摇曳。
rows.target_text: Elegant and simple, the loose hair falls like Aersilk, suggesting quiet contemplation as it sways gently in the breeze.
rows.official_target_text: Elegant and simple, the loose hair falls like Aersilk, suggesting quiet contemplation as it sways gently in the breeze.

rows.source_text: 沉绿紧身衣搭配浅绿罩衣，仿照古时蓑衣制成，具有良好的防水功效。
rows.target_text: A snug, form-fitting lining paired with a pale green coat inspired by traditional rain cloaks.
rows.official_target_text: A snug, form-fitting lining paired with a pale green coat inspired by traditional rain cloaks.

rows.source_text: 鞋面皎洁如云絮，令人不忍沾染尘埃，每一步都像轻踩在云镜湖的倒影中。
rows.target_text: The shoes are as white as clouds, begging to stay spotless. Each step feels like walking on the calm reflection of Mirror Lake.
rows.official_target_text: The shoes are as white as clouds, begging to stay spotless. Each step feels like walking on the calm reflection of Mirror Lake.

rows.source_text: 玄发高盘，忽现几抹朱红，宛若星火燎原。
rows.target_text: Dark hair coiled high, with streaks of vermilion appearing like a prairie fire.
rows.official_target_text: Dark hair coiled high, with streaks of vermilion appearing like a prairie fire.

rows.source_text: 以便捷、容易打理为核心特点的发型，可以体会到天柱墟中人的普遍气质。
rows.target_text: A simple, low-maintenance style that's easy to care for, reflecting the practical spirit of the Underhall people.
rows.official_target_text: A simple, low-maintenance style that's easy to care for, reflecting the practical spirit of the Underhall people.

rows.source_text: 轻便的浅色鞋子，搭配可爱绒球，让人想起风物家活跃的身影。
rows.target_text: Light-colored shoes with cute pom-poms, reminiscent of the active figures of the Fengwu family.
rows.official_target_text: Light-colored shoes with cute pom-poms, reminiscent of the active figures of the Fengwu family.

rows.source_text: 年轻的狩猎者，身影轻盈，于山林间，寻找自己的轨迹。
rows.target_text: A young hunter, light on their feet, seeking their own path through the mountains and forests.
rows.official_target_text: A young hunter, light on their feet, seeking their own path through the mountains and forests.

rows.source_text: 有着可爱爪印的蓝色长袜，游猎家的最爱。
rows.target_text: Azure stockings featuring cute claw prints, beloved by Hunters.
rows.official_target_text: Azure stockings featuring cute claw prints, beloved by Hunters.

rows.source_text: 带有暗红色调的黑色下装，布料轻韧，给人神秘而干练的印象。
rows.target_text: Black bottoms with dark red tones. The fabric is light and durable, giving off a mysterious and capable impression.
rows.official_target_text: Black bottoms with dark red tones. The fabric is light and durable, giving off a mysterious and capable impression.

rows.source_text: 云织水纹，衣染潮声，海韵流转，风托浪语成歌。
rows.target_text: Clouds weave water patterns, garments stained with the sound of tides; sea rhythms swirl, wind carries wave-whispers into song.
rows.official_target_text: Clouds weave water patterns, garments stained with the sound of tides; sea rhythms swirl, wind carries wave-whispers into song.

rows.source_text: 奔跑时裤脚翻飞，云纹流动，仿佛下一秒就要起飞。
rows.target_text: Fluttering cuffs and flowing aerveins make it feel ready for takeoff.
rows.official_target_text: Fluttering cuffs and flowing aerveins make it feel ready for takeoff.

rows.source_text: 学姐学长们有句心照不宣的台词：“既然您这么说了，那就这么办吧。”
rows.target_text: Seniors all have a tacit line, "If you said so, let's go with it."
rows.official_target_text: Seniors all have a tacit line, "If you said so, let's go with it."

rows.source_text: 轻巧飘逸的上装，灵动而又有山中青鹤的优雅高洁。
rows.target_text: Light and elegant top, agile and possessing the elegance and purity of a green crane in the mountains.
rows.official_target_text: Light and elegant top, agile and possessing the elegance and purity of a green crane in the mountains.

rows.source_text: 形似一字的羽饰，表明鲲梦决中的杰出成就。至少本意如此。
rows.target_text: A plume designed to honor outstanding achievements in Bubble Fish Dream. Whether it truly fulfills its purpose is anyone's guess.
rows.official_target_text: A plume designed to honor outstanding achievements in Bubble Fish Dream. Whether it truly fulfills its purpose is anyone's guess.

rows.source_text: 眼中火花乱跳，耳间噼啪作响，他们捣鼓火器时，似乎丝毫不怕烧到发梢。
rows.target_text: Sparks fly and crackling sounds fill the air. When they tinker with their cannons, they seem to have no fear of scorching their hair.
rows.official_target_text: Sparks fly and crackling sounds fill the air. When they tinker with their cannons, they seem to have no fear of scorching their hair.

rows.source_text: 深蓝云织上衣，搭配浅色护颈，四方行游，悠然而自在。
rows.target_text: A navy blue top with a light collar, offering an effortless style for explorers who roam far and wide.
rows.official_target_text: A navy blue top with a light collar, offering an effortless style for explorers who roam far and wide.

rows.source_text: 山青与云白搭配的衣装，洒脱行走，如山中清风。
rows.target_text: An outfit of mountain green and cloud white, capturing the grace and ease of a mountain breeze.
rows.official_target_text: An outfit of mountain green and cloud white, capturing the grace and ease of a mountain breeze.

rows.source_text: 能发出蒲牢浑厚吼叫声的吹角，常为战争之先声。
rows.target_text: A horn that makes the deep, thundering roar of Pu Lao - it's usually the first sound of war.
rows.official_target_text: A horn that makes the deep, thundering roar of Pu Lao - it's usually the first sound of war.

rows.source_text: 海风镌刻褶痕，如浪涛穿行晴空，泊向无垠碧海。
rows.target_text: The sea breeze etches creases, like waves traveling through the clear sky, mooring toward the boundless azure sea.
rows.official_target_text: The sea breeze etches creases, like waves traveling through the clear sky, mooring toward the boundless azure sea.

rows.source_text: 面料抗皱耐磨，剪裁便于活动，这件轻装便是绘影家探索天地的可靠伙伴。
rows.target_text: Durable, wrinkle-resistant, and designed for freedom of movement, this outfit is the Snapsters' favorite for exploring the world.
rows.official_target_text: Durable, wrinkle-resistant, and designed for freedom of movement, this outfit is the Snapsters' favorite for exploring the world.

rows.source_text: 衣襟轻展，如风剪春纱，幽兰芬芳，沉淀过往微光。
rows.target_text: The lapels unfold lightly like wind-cut spring silk, carrying the fragrance of orchids and settling the faint glimmers of the past.
rows.official_target_text: The lapels unfold lightly like wind-cut spring silk, carrying the fragrance of orchids and settling the faint glimmers of the past.

rows.source_text: 云雾水波图案的面纱，让人想起稷下的风雅。
rows.target_text: A veil with mist and water ripple patterns, evoking the refined elegance of Jixia.
rows.official_target_text: A veil with mist and water ripple patterns, evoking the refined elegance of Jixia.

rows.source_text: 形似货币的仿云贝饰品，有云贝广进的祝愿，在游商中很受欢迎。
rows.target_text: Favored by wandering merchants, this accessory is designed to look like Aershells. It symbolizes the wearer's wish to achieve wealth and success.
rows.official_target_text: Favored by wandering merchants, this accessory is designed to look like Aershells. It symbolizes the wearer's wish to achieve wealth and success.

rows.source_text: 墨炎伏身，如龙蛰渊，不动声色为敛气藏锋。
rows.target_text: A dragon hides inside, keeping its sharpness hidden until the right moment to reveal it.
rows.official_target_text: A dragon hides inside, keeping its sharpness hidden until the right moment to reveal it.

rows.source_text: 健壮而阳光的萝卜皮，带来秋天丰收的喜悦。
rows.target_text: A sturdy and sunny radish skin, bringing the joy of the autumn harvest.
rows.official_target_text: A sturdy and sunny radish skin, bringing the joy of the autumn harvest.

rows.source_text: 如晨雾轻抚，携着稷下诗意，透露着时光的洗练与雅致，简洁的外衫。
rows.target_text: Dawn mist brushes the skin, carrying Jixia's timeless, poetic elegance.
rows.official_target_text: Dawn mist brushes the skin, carrying Jixia's timeless, poetic elegance.

rows.source_text: 武道学子们练武时会收拢裤脚，平日却想穿得飘逸抢眼。
rows.target_text: Martial Arts students roll up their pant cuffs for practice, but they also love flashy clothes.
rows.official_target_text: Martial Arts students roll up their pant cuffs for practice, but they also love flashy clothes.

rows.source_text: 火器家们常把裤尾收拢，说这样方便打磨零件。
rows.target_text: Cannoneers often taper their pant legs, claiming it's easier to polish parts that way.
rows.official_target_text: Cannoneers often taper their pant legs, claiming it's easier to polish parts that way.

rows.source_text: 登临重霄的强者方可驾驭的火铳，寄宿着传说中的龙之子的力量。
rows.target_text: A firearm reserved for the mightiest who have risen to the heavens, infused with the power of a legendary dragon's heir.
rows.official_target_text: A firearm reserved for the mightiest who have risen to the heavens, infused with the power of a legendary dragon's heir.

rows.source_text: 素色裤装，精密纺织，利落贴身，适合潜行和战斗。
rows.target_text: Finely woven trousers in muted hues, sleek and form-fitting, ideal for stealth and combat.
rows.official_target_text: Finely woven trousers in muted hues, sleek and form-fitting, ideal for stealth and combat.

rows.source_text: 神秘而智慧的叶子，上知天文下知地理……未卜先知。
rows.target_text: A mysterious and wise leaf that knows everything from astronomy to geography... and can foresee the future.
rows.official_target_text: A mysterious and wise leaf that knows everything from astronomy to geography... and can foresee the future.

rows.source_text: 鬓发轻绾，一缕霞光藏于金簪之上，仿佛风动麦浪，光摇鱼影。
rows.target_text: The hair is softly pinned up, a strand of dawn light nestles on the golden hairpin, as if the wheat waves are dancing in the wind with the light reflected on the fish.
rows.official_target_text: The hair is softly pinned up, a strand of dawn light nestles on the golden hairpin, as if the wheat waves are dancing in the wind with the light reflected on the fish.

rows.source_text: 正面是利落帅气的短发，发尾在身后束起，发饰让人联想到玄雍某些传说。
rows.target_text: The front features neat, cool short hair, with the ends tied back. The hair accessory is reminiscent of certain legends from Xuan Yong.
rows.official_target_text: The front features neat, cool short hair, with the ends tied back. The hair accessory is reminiscent of certain legends from Xuan Yong.

rows.source_text: 小麻袋，大世界，一起去远航吧，可爱的蔬菜精灵!
rows.target_text: Small sack, big world, let's set sail together, cute vegetable sprite!
rows.official_target_text: Small sack, big world, let's set sail together, cute vegetable sprite!

rows.source_text: 火炉静静的燃烧，窗外雪花静悄悄，抱着毛茸茸的暖手炉，做一个休憩的梦。
rows.target_text: The stove burns quietly, snowflakes fall silently outside the window. Holding a fluffy hand warmer, dreaming a restful dream.
rows.official_target_text: The stove burns quietly, snowflakes fall silently outside the window. Holding a fluffy hand warmer, dreaming a restful dream.

rows.source_text: 依机关鱼型而仿制的青铜头胄，坚固又神秘。金色的鱼眼，照亮探索之路。
rows.target_text: The bronze helmet, resembling a Mechcraft fish, is both sturdy and mysterious. The golden fish eyes illuminate the path of discovery.
rows.official_target_text: The bronze helmet, resembling a Mechcraft fish, is both sturdy and mysterious. The golden fish eyes illuminate the path of discovery.

rows.source_text: 会变脸的青铜机关人，不要轻易摇晃它哦......
rows.target_text: Don't shake it. It might get angry.
rows.official_target_text: Don't shake it. It might get angry.

rows.source_text: 装满了节日的收获，正所谓年年有余。
rows.target_text: Packed with the harvest of the festivals! As the saying goes, "Plenty year after year!"
rows.official_target_text: Packed with the harvest of the festivals! As the saying goes, "Plenty year after year!"

rows.source_text: 银青色云丝鞋，柔韧轻巧，伴随学子踏入晴光。
rows.target_text: Silver-blue cloud-silk shoes, flexible and lightweight, accompanying students as they step into the clear light.
rows.official_target_text: Silver-blue cloud-silk shoes, flexible and lightweight, accompanying students as they step into the clear light.

rows.source_text: 长袍剪裁典雅，只在独具匠心的宽袖里藏入一缕云与风。
rows.target_text: The robe is elegantly cut, with a wisp of cloud and wind ingeniously concealed within its carefully tailored sleeves.
rows.official_target_text: The robe is elegantly cut, with a wisp of cloud and wind ingeniously concealed within its carefully tailored sleeves.

rows.source_text: 来自星空的祝福，闪闪发光的温柔，化作金灿灿的帽子，伴随新的旅程。
rows.target_text: A blessing from the stars—twinkling love spun into a glimmering hat, ready to join your newest adventure.
rows.official_target_text: A blessing from the stars—twinkling love spun into a glimmering hat, ready to join your newest adventure.

rows.source_text: 绣着海浪纹的渐变色短上衣，据说衣服上的金线是用颜色明亮的咬指木染成。
rows.target_text: A top that fades in a smooth gradient, decorated with delicate wave embroidery. The shimmering gold threads owe their rich color to dye made from bright Bitewood.
rows.official_target_text: A top that fades in a smooth gradient, decorated with delicate wave embroidery. The shimmering gold threads owe their rich color to dye made from bright Bitewood.

rows.source_text: 基础款厨帽，简约不简单，一如烹饪往往在原材中才品得真味。
rows.target_text: A basic chef's hat, simple yet refined—much like cooking itself. Only by tasting raw ingredients can one discover their true flavor.
rows.official_target_text: A basic chef's hat, simple yet refined—much like cooking itself. Only by tasting raw ingredients can one discover their true flavor.

rows.source_text: 衣襟轻展，如风剪春纱，幽兰芬芳，沉淀过往微光。
rows.target_text: The lapels unfold lightly like wind-cut spring silk, carrying the fragrance of orchids and settling the faint glimmers of the past.
rows.official_target_text: The lapels unfold lightly like wind-cut spring silk, carrying the fragrance of orchids and settling the faint glimmers of the past.

rows.source_text: 金色雕饰的深色葫芦饮壶，搭配坠穗和描金花，质感非凡，尽展豪爽气概。
rows.target_text: An exquisite dark gourd flask adorned with golden carvings, tassels, and painted floral accents, brimming with bold, heroic flair.
rows.official_target_text: An exquisite dark gourd flask adorned with golden carvings, tassels, and painted floral accents, brimming with bold, heroic flair.

rows.source_text: 月光凝成红玉，鞋跟叩响时，沉睡地窖百年的秘密开始苏醒。
rows.target_text: Moonlight crystallizes into red jade. With the clicking of heels, century-old secrets in the cellar begin to awake.
rows.official_target_text: Moonlight crystallizes into red jade. With the clicking of heels, century-old secrets in the cellar begin to awake.

rows.source_text: 版型十分规整的裤子，穿着走路时，下摆会漾开层层波浪。
rows.target_text: A pair of impeccably tailored pants. With every step, the pant legs ripple like waves.
rows.official_target_text: A pair of impeccably tailored pants. With every step, the pant legs ripple like waves.

rows.source_text: 浅色蓝白的上装，乍看清新，锁边的深紫却依稀藏匿着幽梦。
rows.target_text: Where the Dream Rift gapes wide, radiance and shadows glide forth. You don't need to be in a dream to dress in a feathered robe and walk with cloud-veiled boots.
rows.official_target_text: Where the Dream Rift gapes wide, radiance and shadows glide forth. You don't need to be in a dream to dress in a feathered robe and walk with cloud-veiled boots.

rows.source_text: 百草家行走山野时，用于暂放药材的药箩，容量不大，胜在便利。
rows.target_text: A medicine basket Herbalists use when roaming the wild. It doesn't hold much, but it's very convenient to carry.
rows.official_target_text: A medicine basket Herbalists use when roaming the wild. It doesn't hold much, but it's very convenient to carry.

rows.source_text: 河道之灵暗下决心，奋斗百天，抵达武道极致。
rows.target_text: The River Sprite has made up its mind to train hard for a hundred days until it reaches the pinnacle of martial arts.
rows.official_target_text: The River Sprite has made up its mind to train hard for a hundred days until it reaches the pinnacle of martial arts.

rows.source_text: 饰有丝带的短靴，灵便易行，护佑探索的脚步。
rows.target_text: Ribboned ankle boots that ensure swift, light-footed travel on any expedition.
rows.official_target_text: Ribboned ankle boots that ensure swift, light-footed travel on any expedition.

rows.source_text: 将夜色轻披于身，灿烂的光辉，牵引远星的回应。
rows.target_text: Draped in the night, the brilliant radiance draws a response from distant stars.
rows.official_target_text: Draped in the night, the brilliant radiance draws a response from distant stars.

rows.source_text: 紫八鱼玩偶稳坐头顶，小心翼翼握住发丝，随游猎家一起踏上探险之旅。
rows.target_text: A Violet Snapper perches atop the head, clutching the hair with great care as it accompanies the Hunter on every adventure.
rows.official_target_text: A Violet Snapper perches atop the head, clutching the hair with great care as it accompanies the Hunter on every adventure.

rows.source_text: 天晴雨停，游动于江中的阴阳鱼也消失不见，收伞瞬间，似乎领悟万物之理。
rows.target_text: The sky clears and the rain stops, and the yin-yang fish swimming in the river vanish. In the moment of closing the umbrella, one seems to grasp the principles of all things.
rows.official_target_text: The sky clears and the rain stops, and the yin-yang fish swimming in the river vanish. In the moment of closing the umbrella, one seems to grasp the principles of all things.

rows.source_text: “愿水晶归你。”以流之力塑型的垂发，看似寻常，却藏着少女的玲珑匠心。
rows.target_text: "Take the Crystal!" Hair shaped by the power of Flow into a simple, clean style. It looks effortless at first glance, but hides the girl's careful, precise handiwork.
rows.official_target_text: "Take the Crystal!" Hair shaped by the power of Flow into a simple, clean style. It looks effortless at first glance, but hides the girl's careful, precise handiwork.

rows.source_text: 暗红色的精致发饰，优雅古老，颇具海都贵族风情。
rows.target_text: A dark red and elegant hair accessory with an ancient, aristocratic feel from Navenia.
rows.official_target_text: A dark red and elegant hair accessory with an ancient, aristocratic feel from Navenia.

rows.source_text: 威风凛凛的叶子，带有萝侠客独有的味道。
rows.target_text: A majestic leaf, carrying the unique scent of a rogue hero.
rows.official_target_text: A majestic leaf, carrying the unique scent of a rogue hero.

rows.source_text: 朝阳熔金，染尽苍穹云浪，稷下的少年们整理仪容，始换新装。
rows.target_text: As the rising sun turns the clouds to molten gold, the youth of Jixia don their garb for a new day.
rows.official_target_text: As the rising sun turns the clouds to molten gold, the youth of Jixia don their garb for a new day.

rows.source_text: 头顶一大块亮晶晶的云琼矿，让你在人群中一眼就能被看见，秒变最靓的仔。
rows.target_text: With a big, shiny Aernium orb on the head, you'll instantly become the best looking person in the crowd.
rows.official_target_text: With a big, shiny Aernium orb on the head, you'll instantly become the best looking person in the crowd.

rows.source_text: 步履无声，踏入幽谷深处，如晨露凝霜，映出点点碎金阳光。
rows.target_text: Walking silently into the depths of the secluded valley, like morning dew and frost, reflecting bits of golden sunlight.
rows.official_target_text: Walking silently into the depths of the secluded valley, like morning dew and frost, reflecting bits of golden sunlight.

rows.source_text: 以假乱真的装扮，真让人跃跃欲试！小木篱会崇拜地追随我们吗？
rows.target_text: A cunning costume that blends so well that even the little Saepes will be on your trail.
rows.official_target_text: A cunning costume that blends so well that even the little Saepes will be on your trail.

rows.source_text: 一跃而起，落地无声，他的脚下没有终点，他的眼中没有尽头。
rows.target_text: Leaping up, landing without a sound; there is no finish line beneath his feet, and no end in his eyes.
rows.official_target_text: Leaping up, landing without a sound; there is no finish line beneath his feet, and no end in his eyes.

rows.source_text: 借幽夜净自心，琢星月入饰环。拥簇着的蓝瓣光华于无息中疗愈万物。
rows.target_text: Under the starry night, the blue petals heal all life in their peaceful glow.
rows.official_target_text: Under the starry night, the blue petals heal all life in their peaceful glow.

rows.source_text: 优雅的镶金发饰，随佩戴者发髻轻摆，如芳雪初晴。
rows.target_text: A fashionable hair accessory featuring gold inlays, swaying with the wearer's hair like sunlight dancing off the snow.
rows.official_target_text: A fashionable hair accessory featuring gold inlays, swaying with the wearer's hair like sunlight dancing off the snow.

rows.source_text: 雀跃的小星星，随着行走而闪耀，装满梦想与祝福，轻盈踏上新的旅程。
rows.target_text: A skipping little star that sparkles with every step. Fill it with dreams and blessings, then set off on your next journey!
rows.official_target_text: A skipping little star that sparkles with every step. Fill it with dreams and blessings, then set off on your next journey!

rows.source_text: 白色云丝拼织青碧色布料的上衣，利落而别致，星宿扣饰设计令人眼前一亮。
rows.target_text: A stylish top made of white Aersilk and green fabric, featuring a captivating constellation button detail.
rows.official_target_text: A stylish top made of white Aersilk and green fabric, featuring a captivating constellation button detail.

rows.source_text: 幽兰随风而至，步入未醒之梦，一寸一寸，晕染清晨的轮廓。
rows.target_text: Orchids arrive with the wind, stepping into an unawakened dream, inch by inch, staining the outline of the morning.
rows.official_target_text: Orchids arrive with the wind, stepping into an unawakened dream, inch by inch, staining the outline of the morning.

rows.source_text: 形似货币的仿云贝饰品，有云贝广进的祝愿，在游商中很受欢迎。
rows.target_text: Favored by wandering merchants, this accessory is designed to look like Aershells. It symbolizes the wearer's wish to achieve wealth and success.
rows.official_target_text: Favored by wandering merchants, this accessory is designed to look like Aershells. It symbolizes the wearer's wish to achieve wealth and success.

rows.source_text: 青春干练的头发，既便于行医问药，又保留了少年医者的朝气。
rows.target_text: A short, sharp cut that keeps hair out of your face for medical work—practical, low-maintenance, and full of youthful energy.
rows.official_target_text: A short, sharp cut that keeps hair out of your face for medical work—practical, low-maintenance, and full of youthful energy.

rows.source_text: 夜幕披落肩头，猩红轻染发梢，如月色迷梦，也似深渊流火。
rows.target_text: Night falls upon the shoulders, and scarlet tints the hair, like the abyss smoldering in a moonlit reverie.
rows.official_target_text: Night falls upon the shoulders, and scarlet tints the hair, like the abyss smoldering in a moonlit reverie.

rows.source_text: 暗色的铸甲，装饰有已经黯淡的纹样，在遥远的往日里，或许也曾熠熠生辉。
rows.target_text: A dark armor top marked with faded motifs, showing a weathered, storied presence.
rows.official_target_text: A dark armor top marked with faded motifs, showing a weathered, storied presence.

rows.source_text: 蕴藏着流之力的白金抹额。当陷入迷茫和不甘时，此物会提醒你何为初心。
rows.target_text: A white-gold forehead band infused with the power of Flow. When you feel lost or frustrated, it serves as a reminder of what you set out for.
rows.official_target_text: A white-gold forehead band infused with the power of Flow. When you feel lost or frustrated, it serves as a reminder of what you set out for.

rows.source_text: 云雾水波图案的面纱，让人想起稷下的风雅。
rows.target_text: A veil with mist and water ripple patterns, evoking the refined elegance of Jixia.
rows.official_target_text: A veil with mist and water ripple patterns, evoking the refined elegance of Jixia.

rows.source_text: 灵便轻巧的靴子，行过山川，前路仍是新程。
rows.target_text: Comfortable, lightweight boots that carry you over mountains and rivers, to many new journeys ahead.
rows.official_target_text: Comfortable, lightweight boots that carry you over mountains and rivers, to many new journeys ahead.

rows.source_text: 由尘鹿皮制成的长筒靴，风物家们野外探险的最爱。
rows.target_text: Long boots made from Cloud Stag leather, a favorite of Seekers for outdoor adventures.
rows.official_target_text: Long boots made from Cloud Stag leather, a favorite of Seekers for outdoor adventures.

rows.source_text: 衣袖上绘着云霞暗纹，上身自带仙气飘飘的清冷滤镜。
rows.target_text: The sleeves are adorned with subtle cloud patterns, giving the wearer an ethereal, cool-toned aura.
rows.official_target_text: The sleeves are adorned with subtle cloud patterns, giving the wearer an ethereal, cool-toned aura.

rows.source_text: 峡谷的风正在吹来胜利的气息，即使隔着头盔也能闻到。
rows.target_text: The victory wind of the Gorge blows. You can even smell it with the helmet on.
rows.official_target_text: The victory wind of the Gorge blows. You can even smell it with the helmet on.

rows.source_text: 戴上以咕呱为原型设计的挂饰，意味着佩戴者获得了“咕呱大哥”的认可。
rows.target_text: Wearing it shows you've earned Boss Croaky's recognition.
rows.official_target_text: Wearing it shows you've earned Boss Croaky's recognition.

rows.source_text: 透气舒适的袜子，轻薄如雾霭，行之若清风。
rows.target_text: These breathable, comfortable socks, light as mist, let you move like a breeze.
rows.official_target_text: These breathable, comfortable socks, light as mist, let you move like a breeze.

rows.source_text: 露趾长靴包裹小腿，寻找鱼点的路上，既能翻越小山丘，也可踩水渡河滩。
rows.target_text: Open-toed, calf-high boots made for climbing hills and wading rivers while scouting fishing spots.
rows.official_target_text: Open-toed, calf-high boots made for climbing hills and wading rivers while scouting fishing spots.

rows.source_text: 外观让人联想到锋利的爪牙，据说来源于猩红色的巨大神兽。
rows.target_text: The design resembles sharp claws and teeth, and it is believed to be inspired by a massive red mythical beast.
rows.official_target_text: The design resembles sharp claws and teeth, and it is believed to be inspired by a massive red mythical beast.

rows.source_text: 云纹装饰是稷下的，但裤子款式不是，据说这是上一代优秀新生自己的发挥。
rows.target_text: Bottoms with a cloud print inspired by Jixia and an original cut by a gifted former student.
rows.official_target_text: Bottoms with a cloud print inspired by Jixia and an original cut by a gifted former student.

rows.source_text: 鲜亮的下装，正适合融入丰云野的庆典里，在一年耕耘之后，尽情享受欢腾。
rows.target_text: These vibrant trousers are perfect for blending into the festivities of Harvest Fields.
rows.official_target_text: These vibrant trousers are perfect for blending into the festivities of Harvest Fields.

rows.source_text: 简洁潇洒的下装，看起来很方便作战和潜行，逃跑起来也很方便。
rows.target_text: Simple and sleek pants, ideal for combat, stealth, and easy escapes.
rows.official_target_text: Simple and sleek pants, ideal for combat, stealth, and easy escapes.

rows.source_text: 步履不停的行者，带着一身无拘快意，轻踏金色蒹葭纹短靴，且战且歌。
rows.target_text: The travelers' journey knows no end. In short boots stitched with golden reeds, they fight and sing.
rows.official_target_text: The travelers' journey knows no end. In short boots stitched with golden reeds, they fight and sing.

rows.source_text: 纹路如江上行波，纷纷雨落中，踏浪而至。
rows.target_text: Patterns like ripples on a river, arriving on the waves amidst the falling rain.
rows.official_target_text: Patterns like ripples on a river, arriving on the waves amidst the falling rain.

rows.source_text: 眼中火花乱跳，耳边噼啪作响，道场奋战的激情，仿佛要点燃发梢。
rows.target_text: Eyes blaze with dancing sparks and ears ring with a crackling buzz. The passion of the training hall is ready to set the tips of hair ablaze.
rows.official_target_text: Eyes blaze with dancing sparks and ears ring with a crackling buzz. The passion of the training hall is ready to set the tips of hair ablaze.

rows.source_text: 渐变色短下装，遍布可爱的爪印，变身成为小动物们最喜欢的游猎家。
rows.target_text: These gradient shorts covered in adorable paw prints will turn you into the animals' favorite Hunter.
rows.official_target_text: These gradient shorts covered in adorable paw prints will turn you into the animals' favorite Hunter.

rows.source_text: 青铜为构，萤石作芯。那跨越万千光阴仍在灼灼发光的，究竟是谁人的执念？
rows.target_text: With a frame cast in bronze and fluorite at its core, it still glows after thousands of years—the stubborn legacy of some forgotten artisan.
rows.official_target_text: With a frame cast in bronze and fluorite at its core, it still glows after thousands of years—the stubborn legacy of some forgotten artisan.

rows.source_text: 以假乱真的装扮，真让人跃跃欲试！小木篱会崇拜地追随我们吗？
rows.target_text: A cunning costume that blends so well that even the little Saepes will be on your trail.
rows.official_target_text: A cunning costume that blends so well that even the little Saepes will be on your trail.

rows.source_text: 无名者的意志终于被倾听，他们的祈愿会永远庇佑这片土地的学子。
rows.target_text: At last, the will of the nameless is heard—their prayers shall bless the students on these grounds for all eternity.
rows.official_target_text: At last, the will of the nameless is heard—their prayers shall bless the students on these grounds for all eternity.

rows.source_text: 能发出蒲牢浑厚吼叫声的吹角，常为战争之先声。
rows.target_text: A horn that makes the deep, thundering roar of Pu Lao - it's usually the first sound of war.
rows.official_target_text: A horn that makes the deep, thundering roar of Pu Lao - it's usually the first sound of war.

rows.source_text: 风撩动发丝，耳尖微颤，他偏过头，鼻尖嗅闻远方。
rows.target_text: The wind stirs his hair, his ear tips twitch, and he turns his head to sniff the distance.
rows.official_target_text: The wind stirs his hair, his ear tips twitch, and he turns his head to sniff the distance.

rows.source_text: 窥见梦中预言者，以幽邃影纱覆面。不见百相，弃绝悲喜，静候寂灭之刻。
rows.target_text: Glimpsing the prophet in a dream, face covered by a deep shadow veil. Seeing no faces, abandoning joy and sorrow, waiting quietly for the moment of extinction.
rows.official_target_text: Glimpsing the prophet in a dream, face covered by a deep shadow veil. Seeing no faces, abandoning joy and sorrow, waiting quietly for the moment of extinction.

rows.source_text: 如桃花般柔和，东方风格的长裤，落雪的庭院里，展现风物家活跃的身影。
rows.target_text: Soft as peach blossoms, Eastern-style trousers, showcasing the active figure of a naturalist in a snow-dusted courtyard.
rows.official_target_text: Soft as peach blossoms, Eastern-style trousers, showcasing the active figure of a naturalist in a snow-dusted courtyard.

rows.source_text: 黑色中长袜，点缀鳞片风格金饰，自在悠游。
rows.target_text: Black mid-calf socks embellished with scale-style gold ornaments, perfect for wandering freely.
rows.official_target_text: Black mid-calf socks embellished with scale-style gold ornaments, perfect for wandering freely.

rows.source_text: 时下流行的慵懒发型，长辈觉得像没睡醒，但理发师认为帅得很清醒。
rows.target_text: A trendy hairstyle. Your parents might think you look sleepy, but your stylist thinks it's stylish.
rows.official_target_text: A trendy hairstyle. Your parents might think you look sleepy, but your stylist thinks it's stylish.

rows.source_text: 装满了节日的收获，正所谓年年有余。
rows.target_text: Packed with the harvest of the festivals! As the saying goes, "Plenty year after year!"
rows.official_target_text: Packed with the harvest of the festivals! As the saying goes, "Plenty year after year!"

rows.source_text: 优雅长衫，遍落香蕊，让人想起晨曦中盛放的花庭，明亮耀眼，朝气蓬勃。
rows.target_text: An elegant long robe adorned with fragrant stamens, reminiscent of a garden in full bloom at dawn—bright, dazzling, and full of vitality.
rows.official_target_text: An elegant long robe adorned with fragrant stamens, reminiscent of a garden in full bloom at dawn—bright, dazzling, and full of vitality.

rows.source_text: 以皮带束起的裤装，垂挂简约装饰，满足应战所需。
rows.target_text: Bottoms tied with a belt, hanging simple decorations, meeting the needs of battle.
rows.official_target_text: Bottoms tied with a belt, hanging simple decorations, meeting the needs of battle.

rows.source_text: 伐石为甲，缀以梧桐。为着装者提供重点防护，使之于远山中自在穿行。
rows.target_text: When the mountains turn crimson with autumn leaves, the view from higher ground is at its most brilliant.
rows.official_target_text: When the mountains turn crimson with autumn leaves, the view from higher ground is at its most brilliant.

rows.source_text: 黑色吞噬光影，暗纹浮现，如残存的烛火，于夜色中摇曳。
rows.target_text: Black devours every gleam, dark patterns emerge, like lingering candlelight flickering in the night.
rows.official_target_text: Black devours every gleam, dark patterns emerge, like lingering candlelight flickering in the night.

rows.source_text: 常见于垂钓家的发型，发丝收束，谨防缠住钓线的意外。
rows.target_text: A hairstyle for Anglers, where the hair is neatly tied up to keep it from getting tangled in the fishing line.
rows.official_target_text: A hairstyle for Anglers, where the hair is neatly tied up to keep it from getting tangled in the fishing line.

rows.source_text: “全体目光看向我，冠军已被星之队预定！”某人在全场注视下将战利品赠了出去。
rows.target_text: "All eyes on me—the championship is reserved for the Team of Stars!" Someone gifted his trophy before the entire audience.
rows.official_target_text: "All eyes on me—the championship is reserved for the Team of Stars!" Someone gifted his trophy before the entire audience.

rows.source_text: 灵动潇洒的短发，让人想起山间行游的时光。
rows.target_text: Lively, dashing short hair that evokes memories of wandering through the mountains.
rows.official_target_text: Lively, dashing short hair that evokes memories of wandering through the mountains.

rows.source_text: 火器家们常把裤尾收拢，说这样方便打磨零件。
rows.target_text: Cannoneers often taper their pant legs, claiming it's easier to polish parts that way.
rows.official_target_text: Cannoneers often taper their pant legs, claiming it's easier to polish parts that way.

rows.source_text: 看起来很有滋味的肉骨头，让大家肚子咕咕叫了起来。
rows.target_text: A juicy-looking meat bone that makes everyone's stomachs growl.
rows.official_target_text: A juicy-looking meat bone that makes everyone's stomachs growl.

rows.source_text: 简约而结实的布囊，装有工巧家必备的基础工具。
rows.target_text: A simple and sturdy cloth pouch, containing the essential tools of every Crafter.
rows.official_target_text: A simple and sturdy cloth pouch, containing the essential tools of every Crafter.

rows.source_text: 常随垂钓家出没于河岸的笠帽，顶部小鱼悠游芦苇之间，成为一景。
rows.target_text: A conical hat commonly worn by Anglers by the river, adorned with a unique charm on top—a little fish swimming among the reeds.
rows.official_target_text: A conical hat commonly worn by Anglers by the river, adorned with a unique charm on top—a little fish swimming among the reeds.

rows.source_text: 稷下机关学院特制饰品，白玉中能量涌动，不时浮现出云流般的漩涡纹路。
rows.target_text: A special accessory from the School of Mechcraft. Energy rises inside the white jade, and a swirling pattern flickers across its surface.
rows.official_target_text: A special accessory from the School of Mechcraft. Energy rises inside the white jade, and a swirling pattern flickers across its surface.

rows.source_text: 英姿飒爽的侧分短发，深色如冬日松林。
rows.target_text: A crisp, side-parted short hairstyle, dark as winter pines.
rows.official_target_text: A crisp, side-parted short hairstyle, dark as winter pines.

rows.source_text: 云雾水波图案的面纱，让人想起稷下的风雅。
rows.target_text: A veil with mist and water ripple patterns, evoking the refined elegance of Jixia.
rows.official_target_text: A veil with mist and water ripple patterns, evoking the refined elegance of Jixia.

rows.source_text: 以耐磨材料纺织而成的长袜，保护皮肤不被山间荆棘所伤。
rows.target_text: Durable, woven socks that protect the skin from mountain thorns.
rows.official_target_text: Durable, woven socks that protect the skin from mountain thorns.

rows.source_text: 以加韧纱线织就白袜，伴人踏出悠然而充满活力的步伐。
rows.target_text: Woven from reinforced yarn, these white socks let you walk with both energy and ease.
rows.official_target_text: Woven from reinforced yarn, these white socks let you walk with both energy and ease.

rows.source_text: 深色下装，舒适自在，踏遍千山万水，尽显行者的洒脱。
rows.target_text: Dark bottoms that are comfortable and relaxed, capturing the free-spirited nature of a traveler across landscapes.
rows.official_target_text: Dark bottoms that are comfortable and relaxed, capturing the free-spirited nature of a traveler across landscapes.

rows.source_text: 云雾水波图案的面纱，让人想起稷下的风雅。
rows.target_text: A veil with mist and water ripple patterns, evoking the refined elegance of Jixia.
rows.official_target_text: A veil with mist and water ripple patterns, evoking the refined elegance of Jixia.

rows.source_text: 风物家认证好穿的保暖棉袜，野外徒步的好伙伴。
rows.target_text: Seeker-certified warm cotton socks, a great companion for hiking in the wild.
rows.official_target_text: Seeker-certified warm cotton socks, a great companion for hiking in the wild.

rows.source_text: 风撩动发丝，耳尖微颤，她偏过头，鼻尖嗅闻远方。
rows.target_text: The wind stirs her hair, her ear tips twitch, and she turns her head to sniff the distance.
rows.official_target_text: The wind stirs her hair, her ear tips twitch, and she turns her head to sniff the distance.

rows.source_text: 如江河雨涛，化作鱼龙轻舞，简洁而浪漫的深色上装，适合作战。
rows.target_text: Like river waves, transforming into a dancing fish-dragon; a simple and romantic dark-colored top, suitable for combat.
rows.official_target_text: Like river waves, transforming into a dancing fish-dragon; a simple and romantic dark-colored top, suitable for combat.

rows.source_text: 游猎家定制，十分淡定的藏狐头套，戴上后好像能够看破水猴子的真身了。
rows.target_text: A custom-made, very calm Tibetan fox mask for hunters. Wearing it seems to allow you to see through the true form of water monkeys.
rows.official_target_text: A custom-made, very calm Tibetan fox mask for hunters. Wearing it seems to allow you to see through the true form of water monkeys.

rows.source_text: 火器家们身上总是挂满零碎，说是要随身带的东西实在太多。
rows.target_text: Cannoneers carry around all sorts of trinkets. They say there are too many things they must keep on hand.
rows.official_target_text: Cannoneers carry around all sorts of trinkets. They say there are too many things they must keep on hand.

rows.source_text: 色彩明亮的鱼篓，有效提醒垂钓家新手钓完记得带回。
rows.target_text: A brightly colored fish basket that effectively reminds novice Anglers not to leave it behind after fishing.
rows.official_target_text: A brightly colored fish basket that effectively reminds novice Anglers not to leave it behind after fishing.

rows.source_text: 头顶一大块亮晶晶的云琼矿，让你在人群中一眼就能被看见，秒变最靓的仔。
rows.target_text: With a big, shiny Aernium orb on the head, you'll instantly become the best looking person in the crowd.
rows.official_target_text: With a big, shiny Aernium orb on the head, you'll instantly become the best looking person in the crowd.

rows.source_text: 弥漫着山石般温厚光泽的甲靴。特别注重对膝盖的防护，便于登高拾秋。
rows.target_text: Covered in a warm, stone-like luster, these armored boots have enhanced knee protection. Perfect for autumn climbs.
rows.official_target_text: Covered in a warm, stone-like luster, these armored boots have enhanced knee protection. Perfect for autumn climbs.

rows.source_text: 大眼枭玩偶稳坐头顶，仿佛用揪头发来提示方向，完美点缀你的发型。
rows.target_text: A Big-eye Owlet perches atop your head—could it be tugging at your hair to guide your way? Either way, it's the perfect complement to your hairstyle.
rows.official_target_text: A Big-eye Owlet perches atop your head—could it be tugging at your hair to guide your way? Either way, it's the perfect complement to your hairstyle.

rows.source_text: 形似一字的羽饰，表明鲲梦决中的杰出成就。至少本意如此。
rows.target_text: A plume designed to honor outstanding achievements in Bubble Fish Dream. Whether it truly fulfills its purpose is anyone's guess.
rows.official_target_text: A plume designed to honor outstanding achievements in Bubble Fish Dream. Whether it truly fulfills its purpose is anyone's guess.

rows.source_text: 让人联想起危险的红色隼鸟，具有金色羽边的华丽面具。
rows.target_text: A lavish mask inspired by the perilous Red Falcon, embellished with gold-trimmed feathers.
rows.official_target_text: A lavish mask inspired by the perilous Red Falcon, embellished with gold-trimmed feathers.

rows.source_text: 工巧家必不可少的工具镜，依稀反射着智慧的光芒。
rows.target_text: Goggles are essential for every crafter and reflect their wisdom.
rows.official_target_text: Goggles are essential for every crafter and reflect their wisdom.

rows.source_text: 百草家随身惯用的小背囊，似乎藏有许多灵丹妙药。
rows.target_text: A small bag often carried by Herbalists, said to contain various medicines.
rows.official_target_text: A small bag often carried by Herbalists, said to contain various medicines.

rows.source_text: 保暖而轻盈的裤装，助力每一次探寻幽奇风景的冒险。
rows.target_text: Warm, light pants that aid in every adventure to explore mysterious landscapes.
rows.official_target_text: Warm, light pants that aid in every adventure to explore mysterious landscapes.

rows.source_text: 摇曳的胖鱼挂饰，来自美好的丰云庆典。
rows.target_text: A swaying plump fish accessory, a memento from the joyous Harvest Festival.
rows.official_target_text: A swaying plump fish accessory, a memento from the joyous Harvest Festival.

rows.source_text: 沉绿紧身衣搭配浅绿罩衣，仿照古时蓑衣制成，具有良好的防水功效。
rows.target_text: A snug, form-fitting lining paired with a pale green coat inspired by traditional rain cloaks.
rows.official_target_text: A snug, form-fitting lining paired with a pale green coat inspired by traditional rain cloaks.

rows.source_text: 白玉青纹，金饰浅履，行者驻足稷下，解析万物魔韵。
